title: Ravi Tharuma
description: Senior counsel for companies that already have a team.
headline: Senior counsel for companies that already have a team.
support: He sits with the people who own the decision, when the next system or agent workflow is too expensive to get wrong.

points.rest: The call is made with the people who own it.
The stack gets shorter, not decorated.

changes.title: The decision
changes.body: Named, owned, and small enough to make.

changes.title: The stack
changes.body: Fewer tools. The ones that remain have an owner.

changes.title: The handoff
changes.body: A system the team runs on a Tuesday, without him.
